summary: Sprint M6 (Membership Register Upgrade) tested end-to-end. 15/15 backend pytest cases pass. All frontend flows (stats strip, filter chips, bulk upload dry-run + real, categories CRUD, member detail edit + persist + cancel, RBAC visibility for district-secretary) pass.

minor.issue: Two CSV aliases in _CSV_ALIAS ('e-mail' and 'sub-category') are dead-keys: _norm_key() replaces hyphens with underscores BEFORE the alias lookup, so headers like 'e-mail' get normalised to 'e_mail' which is not in the alias table. Users writing 'e-mail' will end up with the column dropped. Fix: change alias keys to 'e_mail' and 'sub_category' (harmless — they're already valid canonical names) OR normalise the alias table at import time.

action_items: OPTIONAL — Fix _CSV_ALIAS keys 'e-mail' → 'e_mail' and 'sub-category' → 'sub_category' in /app/backend/routes/members.py (minor CSV alias bug — see minor issues).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/members.py delete_member allows the operation when NO X-Role-Id header is supplied (backwards-compat), so a raw curl with no headers can still delete members. Confirmed intentional in comment but worth flagging.

update_member also permits edits when no headers are supplied. Documented in the docstring as 'backwards compatible with existing dev flows' but this means the UI-hides-the-action is the only guard for legacy callers. Consider enforcing headers in production.
MemberBulkUploadModal — no client-side file-size guard (backend accepts any size). The UI text says 'up to 5 MB' but nothing enforces it.
test_credentials: Persona login (localStorage). Used persona-chip-secretary and persona-chip-district-secretary. See /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: All fixtures create TEST_-prefixed rows and clean up in the teardown / after each test. One residual frontend-created member (TEST_E2E_FE) was manually deleted after the playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_members_m6.py — 15 cases covering M6 (categories CRUD + RBAC, bulk upload dry-run/real with alias/skip rules, /members/stats, list filters, PATCH email-based RBAC, DELETE RBAC). Run via: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest backend/tests/test_members_m6.py -v`. Seeded categories are: Office Bearer, Life Member, Annual Member, District Association, School / Institution (note: spaces around slash), Honorary Member, Patron.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only minor issue is the dead-key aliases in _CSV_ALIAS (fixable in 2 lines).
